name: Neural Parametric Gaussians Optimization
aliases: two-stage optimization for monocular non-rigid reconstruction
definition: A two-stage optimization approach for monocular non-rigid object reconstruction that combines a coarse parametric point model regularized by a low-rank deformation basis with 3D Gaussians to model fine geometric and appearance details efficiently.
summary: Neural Parametric Gaussians Optimization is a two-stage method for monocular non-rigid reconstruction that combines a coarse parametric point model with 3D Gaussians to prevent geometric collapse and maintain structural consistency.
